autoApproveDevelopers.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve developer registration requests
autoApproveDevelopers.description_zh: 是否自动审批开发者注册申请

autoApproveSubscriptions.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically approve API subscription requests
autoApproveSubscriptions.description_zh: 是否自动审批 API 订阅请求

builtinAuthEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable username and password authentication (built-in authentication)
builtinAuthEnabled.description_zh: 是否启用账号密码认证（内置认证）

description_en: Queries the details of a single HiMarket developer portal by portal ID and returns the portal name, description, region ID, portal settings, and portal domain name configurations
description_zh: 按门户 ID 查询单个 HiMarket 开发者门户的详情，返回该门户的 Portal 名称、Portal 描述、地域 ID、Portal 配置与 Portal 域名配置
name: GetPortal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the portal to query. You can obtain this ID from the portalId field in the CreatePortal response or from the portalId field of an item in the ListPortals response. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path to locate the portal, which is the same path used by the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations
parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要查询的门户。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
parameters.name: portal_id

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 (RFC 3339) format in the UTC time zone, such as 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601（RFC 3339），UTC 时区，例如 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z

description.description_en: The portal description, which is the Description property of the portal resource
description.description_zh: Portal 描述，即门户资源 Portal 的 Description 属性
description.example: 面向内部开发者的 HiMarket 门户

name.description_en: The portal name, which is the Name property of the portal resource
name.description_zh: Portal 名称，即门户资源 Portal 的 Name 属性

portalDomainConfig.description_en: The list of portal domain name configurations. The list element is named domainConfig
portalDomainConfig.description_zh: Portal 域名配置列表，列表元素名为 domainConfig

items.description_en: The details of a single portal domain name configuration, including the domain name, request protocol, and domain name type
items.description_zh: 单条 Portal 域名配置详情，包含域名、请求协议与域名类型

portalId.description_en: The portal ID, which is the primary ID of the portal resource and points to the same portal as the portalId request parameter
portalId.description_zh: 门户 ID，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID，与入参 portalId 指向同一个门户

portalSettingConfig.description_en: The portal settings, including whether to enable username and password authentication, whether to automatically approve developer registrations, and whether to automatically approve subscription requests
portalSettingConfig.description_zh: Portal 配置信息，包含是否启用账号密码认证、是否自动审批开发者注册、是否自动审批订阅请求

regionId.description_en: The region ID, which is the RegionId property of the portal resource
regionId.description_zh: 地域 ID，即门户资源 Portal 的 RegionId 属性

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the portal to query. You can obtain this ID from the portalId field in the CreatePortal response or from the portalId field of an item in the ListPortals response. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path to locate the portal, which is the same path used by the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations
v1_parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要查询的门户。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
v1_parameters.name: portalId
